clues.text: This coaster sends riders plunging from a peak height of 206 feet, reaching a top speed of 76 mph through 2 inversions.
Built by Rocky Mountain Construction, this hybrid titan officially opened to the public in 2022.
You can find this ride in Florida at an African-themed park located in Tampa.
Upon its debut, this coaster took the records for being both the fastest and steepest hybrid roller coaster in the world.
The ride's name pairs a durable metallic element with a mythical creature featuring the head of a tiger and the body of a lion.

evidence.quote: Iron Gwazi (formerly called Gwazi) is a steel-track hybrid roller coaster at Busch Gardens Tampa Bay, a theme park in Tampa, Florida, United States.
Iron Gwazi debuted as the tallest hybrid roller coaster in North America, as well as the fastest and steepest hybrid roller coaster in the world.
The ride's name refers to a mythical creature with a tiger's head and a lion's body.
